title: No Determination | EU 261 | New Destination
description:
After disruption on an EU-originating journey, customer was rerouted to a completely different destination than originally booked. DDS cannot assess EU 261 eligibility because the original itinerary no longer matches the actual journey � distance band calculation is impossible when the destination changed. Mirrors APPR new destination test (TC_071).

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger, 2 legs AC operated LHR?YYZ?YVR. Leg 1 (LHR?YYZ): Operated, on time. Leg 2 (YYZ?YVR): CANCELLED. Rerouting: Customer was rebooked to YEG (Edmonton) instead of original destination YVR (Vancouver). New itinerary: YYZ?YEG. Disruption code: 42 (Controllable). Route context: LHR = UK origin ? EU 261 applies.
